RoomType.rationale: CeremonialBeastBoss.RoomType => RoomType.Boss (CeremonialBeastBoss.cs:11). Sim carries no room_type field on the Encounter dataclass; 'ceremonial_beast' is placed in rooms.py:107's boss_keys for _overgrowth_rooms() (seam/rooms_and_map owns the picker itself). GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.BOSS]=(100,100) (rewards.py:173) matches EncounterModel.cs:72/91's Boss=>100/100 defaults, which CeremonialBeastBoss does not override.

CustomBgm.rationale: Pure audio selection ("event:/music/act1_boss_ceremonial_beast"). Its only reader is CombatManager.cs:392's NRunMusicController.PlayCustomMusic -- zero gameplay effect. The headless sim plays no audio.

HasCustomBackground.rationale: Pure visual background selection (protected bool => true, routes GetBackgroundAssets to CreateBackgroundAssetsForCustom instead of the act's generic pool, EncounterModel.cs:188/296-313). No gameplay reader; zero RNG-observable effect in the sim's scope (it only changes which asset bundle is used, not any draw count on a stream the sim models -- CreateBackgroundAssetsForCustom takes an Rng parameter but that Rng is the visuals-only BackgroundAssets ctor's own, never EncounterModel.Rng). The headless sim renders no background.

AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: No sim counterpart. C#'s only consumers of AllPossibleMonsters are ActModel.AllMonsters (ActModel.cs:169, read only by ModelDb.Monsters -> UnlockConsoleCmd.cs:68/147's dev-console 'monsters' listing and NGeneralStatsGrid.cs:164's stats-screen ratio label) and the Bestiary screen (NBestiary.cs:194) -- all UI/dev-console, zero gameplay or RNG effect, confirmed by reading every caller in src/. The headless sim has neither surface, so omitting a counterpart costs nothing observable.

ExtraAssetPaths.rationale: Preloads the Ringing affliction's overlay sprite (ModelDb.Affliction<Ringing>().OverlayPath) so the VFX asset is ready before BEAST_CRY applies it. Its only reader is EncounterModel.GetAssetPaths (EncounterModel.cs:328-343), itself only used for asset preloading -- zero gameplay effect. The Ringing power itself (the mechanical half) is ported independently of this asset list.

GetCameraScaling.rationale: Pure combat-scene camera framing (0.9f). Its only readers are NCombatRoom.cs:188/284/310, Godot node positioning -- zero gameplay effect. The headless sim renders nothing.

GetCameraOffset.rationale: Pure combat-scene camera framing (Vector2.Down * 50f). Its only reader is NCombatRoom.cs:189, Godot node positioning -- zero gameplay effect. The headless sim renders nothing.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: CeremonialBeastBoss.GenerateMonsters (CeremonialBeastBoss.cs:31-34) returns a single-element list: (ModelDb.Monster<CeremonialBeast>().ToMutable(), null) -- zero base.Rng calls, one monster, no slot. Sim's monster_classes=[CeremonialBeast], no slots/monster_slots set (defaults (), sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) and create_monsters draws no RNG for composition (the default implementation this encounter inherits, sts2_rl/monsters/base.py). Roster (1x CeremonialBeast), order (trivial), slot (null/none on both sides) and draw count (0 == 0) all match.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.maps_to: (structural -- Encounter dataclass has no hook methods)
ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: EncounterModel.ShouldReceiveCombatHooks => false (EncounterModel.cs:39), not overridden by CeremonialBeastBoss. The sim's Encounter dataclass (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) declares no hook methods and is never passed to HookSystem.register -- it is plain data, structurally incapable of joining the hook walk, which reproduces 'the encounter itself is not a listener' exactly.

guards.what: MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward gold ladder (the encounter brief's 5th thing to verdict)
guards.rationale: CeremonialBeastBoss does not override MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward, so both inherit EncounterModel.cs:64-100's RoomType ladder (Boss=100-100) times AscensionHelper.PovertyAscensionGoldMultiplier under AscensionLevel.Poverty. CEREMONIAL_BEAST_BOSS carries min_gold=None, max_gold=None (Encounter dataclass default, sts2_rl/monsters/base.py), so rewards.py:875/886-887 falls back to GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.BOSS]=(100,100) (rewards.py:173) -- the same ladder, and rewards.py:875 additionally special-cases the FINAL act's boss (out of Ironclad act-1 scope here). Ascension (Poverty) scaling is out of scope by the audit contract (rewards.py:32's explicit 'no Scarcity/Poverty scaling').

guards.what: EncounterModel.Rng independence (per the encounter brief: verify the sim does not draw encounter rolls off a shared/run-level stream)
guards.rationale: CeremonialBeastBoss.GenerateMonsters makes zero base.Rng calls (CeremonialBeastBoss.cs:31-34, confirmed by reading the whole method) and the sim's create_monsters counterpart makes zero calls to any Rng/random.Random for composition -- there is nothing here for stream identity to diverge on. (Draw-count fact only; which named stream backs EncounterModel.Rng in general is seam/rng_streams' mechanism, already verdicted faithful for the seeding formula at rng_streams step 21.)
